intelligence.enrichment: Unlike poles of two magnets attract each other, while like poles repel each other. A compass needle is also a magnet, so its North pole moves away from another North pole and moves towards a South pole. the pairing of pole names determines attraction or repulsion The learner predicts attraction for unlike poles and repulsion for like poles, including compass-needle cases. Any magnet pole should pull any other magnet pole because magnets are for attracting.
